m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Thank Raven you're here, Wizard. The Aerobots are going crazy! It seems something's got in there and overrode their dadgum circuits.
It all started when that cow thing stormed into town, red as a berry patch in summer and meaner than a hornet before breakfast.
Never seen anything like it... well, come to think of it, I used to have nightmares like this, but never you mind that.
The bull and the bots have people pinned in their Houses. You gotta help 'em, Wizard.
Just in time, Wizard. You saved these evil robots from a vicious dropkicking. Now hit them with fireballs or whatever.
Excellent work, Wizard. I'll clean up here. There are more Dwarves that need your help.
Oh, wonderful, now the Wizard that wrecked the base is here. What a great day I'm having.
Isn't that the one the boss told us to keep from reaching Nimbus?
Yeah, but we're not supposed to say that, you maroon. Just point the hacked robots and the new Mythie at the town and run.
I couldn't run, my shoe was untied. Maybe we should just fight instead.
Looks like a few of the worms slipped through your grasp, Wizard. Good. My squad deserves more personal payback. For RAVEN!
These fiends aren't going anywhere. And when we're done, they'll face Nimbari justice. I'll keep watch here, Wizard, you continue on.
Wizard, you are a stubborn one, aren't you? I kidnapped your friend, sabotaged that Dwarf's Ship... all to keep you away. Yet here you stand.
Yes, it's me, Lord Vanitus. My Cabal friends alerted me that you freed the Captain; I thought you'd be coming back here and arranged a diversion.
Dwarven machines are elegant in their simplicity; intruding upon these systems was easy. And it bought me enough time to complete my goals.
What poisonous goals might those be, Vanitus? What new treasons are you concocting?
Helena! Impossible... you... you're...
Coming for you.
That shut him up. Things sound like they're quieting down. Let's meet the others outside.
That takes care of that mess. Now we just need to get back to Nimbus. Wizard, I assume you placed a Streamportal?
Streamportal? Keras often talked of making something like that.
Sparck built it, a teleportation network connecting all of Empyrea.
Sparck? Good. But we can't use it. Vanitus is expecting us. Your landing point in Nimbus will be guarded. We must take an Aeroship to another dock.
That Mayor Quill owes us a favor. Let's borrow one from him.
Yes. Wizard, you and Pork go talk to the Mayor. We'll meet you at the Aero Pad.
You done us a good turn, Wizard, and I'd lend you an Aeroship to Nimbus... but there is the small matter of the Mythies you were to help with.
The monsters are coming from your imaginations. Your stress, your fear, is bringing your nightmares to life. I'm afraid there is no easy fix.
But tell your people to stop dreading the past, to look toward tomorrow. Believe the world is a better place and you will make it one... together.
Son, that is the single cheesiest thing I have ever heard. You listening to this, Josiah?
Cheesy as a fondue party.
As a fondue party. Still, Paradox Chain being what it is, it ain't impossible. And if we're the cause, by gum, we'll be the solution.
Aero Dwarves solve Aero Dwarf problems. Thanks, Wizard. We got it from here. I'll send word to the Aero Pad. Your Aeroship will be waiting.
Looks like this is our Aeroship. Is everyone ready? There's no telling what Vanitus has in store for us.
Vanitus is a serpent around the Vicereine's neck; he poisons our destiny for his greed. He must be stopped. I stand with you, my Lady.
We have to save Sparck... even if he didn't come to save me... er... us. And we have to do it together. Let's go.
Sparck? Sparck! Come in, Mr. Sparck! Ah, blast this communicator. He's not answering. Sorry, Lady Helena, I can't find your son.
If you left Sparck with Vanitus, he's no doubt in the Central Spire; it's shielded against electrical interference. So communicators are useless.
He staged everything, didn't he? The explosion, the treason, all of it? So he could maintain his secret ties to this Admiral and this Cabal.
That's why I gave my children to Pork to be taken safely away. Then I tried to fight back. I failed. I fled. And I learned to forget.
But now, it's time you remembered. It's time to strike back. For Nimbus. For Empyrea. For... your son.
Perhaps... you are right.... Perhaps it is time. Let us convene at Port Aero. And prepare yourselves for war!
I don't know where you came from, Wizard, but you may have brought my family back to me. Now, onward to Port Aero, to victory!
